DeployBot: starting rollout release-v2.9.1 (commit ab12cd34) to prod regions: us, eu, apac. canary=5% in us, rollout window=02:00-04:00 UTC. :rocket:
Alex Chen: noted. any pinned versions for eu/apac?
Maria Gomez: reminder: change window overlaps batch job at 03:15 UTC in EU — watch CPU/latency.
Samir Patel: watching EU dashboards now, will flag spikes.
Jia Liu: can we hold EU if errors > 2% for 5m? set auto-pin policy?
Alex Chen: yes, proposed policy: if 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p95 latency +30% then pin to previous stable (v2.9.0).
DeployBot: acknowledged. auto-fallback policy set: threshold=1% 5xx, window=180s, fallback_version=release-v2.9.0.
InfraBot: rule applied to eu and apac routes.
Samir Patel: eu canary shows error spike 02:48 UTC - 02:52 UTC, 5xx=1.8% now. recommending immediate pin for eu.
Maria Gomez: +1 pin EU, APAC still steady.
Jia Liu: executing manual pin for eu now:```/deploy pin --env prod --region eu --version release-v2.9.0 --reason "5xx spike"```
DeployBot: received manual pin command, applying pin to eu.
DeployBot: eu pinned to release-v2.9.0 (commit 9f8e7d6), rolling back canary across eu nodes.
Alex Chen: good call. what's the impact on us rollout?
Samir Patel: us continues canary, no regressions so far.
Maria Gomez: notify support that EU is pinned and incident might affect EU customers.
Jia Liu: support pinged.
DeployBot: apac canary at 15% healthy, no action.
InfraBot: scheduled a follow-up evening sweep to validate post-pin metrics.
DeployBot: rollout summary: us: canary -> proceeding, eu: pinned -> rollback to v2.9.0, apac: canary -> paused at 15% (manual hold for monitoring). commit tags: us/apac were on ab12cd34, eu restored to 9f8e7d6.
Alex Chen: file a short release note update: EU pinned due to 5xx spike; non-customer-facing change reverted.
Maria Gomez: I'll draft the release note and post in #release-notes after metrics stabilize.
DeployBot: final status at 03:05 UTC: us continuing deploy, eu pinned, apac paused. next check-in in 30m. :eyes:
